sections.html:
The city straddles two counties, Jefferson and Shelby. The suburb stretches across 20.352 square miles beside U.S. Route 31, with downtown Birmingham 7 miles north and Hoover 4 miles southwest. It combines three named areas, Vestavia, Liberty Park and Cahaba Heights, and carries four ZIP codes: 35216, 35226, 35242 and 35266.

Census takers in 2020 tallied 39,102 residents living in 15,187 households across 15,883 housing units. The 2025 estimate of 38,306 is 2.0 percent lower. It is a settled community, so your likely buyer plans to stay a while.

The story starts with a 1946 subdivision on the southern slope of Shades Mountain. Incorporation came on November 8, 1950, and construction plus annexation did the rest. Population was 4,029 in 1960, 12,250 in 1970, 24,476 in 2000 and 39,102 in 2020.

Because the city tripled in size, its houses come from different building eras. Older ones may need work that newer ones skip, and sellers often weigh an as-is sale against the bill for repairs.

Owners live in most of these homes, and incomes are high by Alabama standards. Homeownership was 76.8 percent in the 2010 census. Newer survey data from 2024 show 13,840 households, 15,014 housing units and median household income of $134,369.

Shoppers here picture your house next to renovated neighbors, and a house waiting on a roof, kitchen or mechanical systems looks weak beside them. Selling straight for cash avoids that contest, but the offer reflects the repairs the buyer inherits.

Recording happens at the probate office for your parcel's county, Jefferson or Shelby. The tax bill names the county. Confirm it before a closing is scheduled, since each office has its own records and fees.

Code of Alabama section 40-22-1 creates the recordation tax: 50 cents on each $500 conveyed, counting any fraction of $500. When a mortgage or vendor's lien already paid mortgage tax, that amount is not taxed again. The deed travels with proof of the real price on a Department of Revenue form.

At filing, the probate judge computes the tax. A person who knowingly holds back proof of value after being asked owes whichever is greater, $100 or 25 percent of the tax. Deeds written for nominal consideration to perfect title, and corrected deeds, fall outside the tax.

sections.h2: Property tax dates and unpaid bills
sections.html:
Property tax is due October 1 and falls delinquent after December 31. If a bill stays unpaid, the process moves on a fixed schedule:

DateStep for an unpaid property tax bill
October 1Bill comes due
January 1Bill is delinquent
FebruaryProbate court receives unpaid bills
AprilDelinquent property is advertised
MayTax sale is possible

A county is not obliged to mail notices, so a bill that never arrived is not a defense. After a mid-year sale the bill may still list the previous owner, yet whoever owns the property owes its tax. Write down who pays which share.

Owners also have to sign a new assessment by December 31 for improvements or removals finished by October 1, for example additions, pools, decks or a new garage. Re-roofing, minor repairs and painting do not require a reassessment.

Alabama's homestead rule covers one single-family house you live in, plus land up to 160 acres. You qualify for a year if you occupied the house on that year's first day. Owners over 65, owners who are permanently and totally disabled and blind owners are exempt from the state portion of the tax, though county taxes may still be owed.

The county office takes the application, and the city does not. Shelby-side owners go to Shelby's office, and Jefferson-side owners go to Jefferson's. If you inherit a house that had an exemption, ask that office what changes at transfer.

The city runs its own school district, Vestavia Hills City Schools, with five elementary schools, two middle schools, one alternative school and one high school for about 6,000 students. Liberty Park Middle School opened in August 2008. Parents ask where an address is zoned, so verify that with the district office.

Residents use Wald Park, Byrd Park, McCallum Park, the Liberty Park Sports Complex, the Sicard Hollow Athletic Complex and the Cahaba Heights fields. Max Transit, operated by the Birmingham-Jefferson County Transit Authority, provides buses, and U.S. 31 is the main road through town. If you did any work on the house, ask the city's building and code offices about permits and inspections.

sections.h2: Selling with taxes or a loan owed
sections.html:
A loan or tax bill still outstanding does not rule out a sale. At closing, the agent gets a payoff number from the lender and a balance from the county and settles both out of what the buyer pays. Begin with the county tax office, find out what is owed for each year with a balance, and ask whether an improvement was left off the assessment.

Hold on to proof of any homestead exemption in case the office asks. Bring that proof, a photo ID and your latest bill when you visit the county in person. Cash sales can close fast, which helps against a deadline, though a firm date comes only after the title is reviewed.

Paperwork slows more closings than houses do, so a Vestavia Hills seller with two possible counties should work through this list:

  • Confirm whether the parcel is in Jefferson or Shelby County.
  • Pull the latest tax bill and see whether anything is unpaid.
  • Gather proof of the price for the recordation tax form.
  • Report improvements finished by October 1 to the county assessing office.
  • If the owner has died, find out whether probate must finish before a deed can be signed.

Recording works the same with a cash buyer. Speed and repairs are what differ: nothing needs fixing, painting or clearing before you hand over the house. A written offer depends on the house, the title and the numbers, so the figure comes after we look at all three.

Start by telling us about the house and why you are selling. We review the details and respond with an offer. If you accept, a title company or attorney confirms ownership, requests payoffs and picks a closing date with you.

On closing day, bring a photo ID, the deed or estate papers and your lender's payoff details. You sign, the loan and any tax are paid from the proceeds, and the balance is yours. You can say no at any point before you sign, so compare the offer with a listing first.

If the house is vacant, confirm your insurance still applies and keep the yard maintained. If a tenant lives there, share the lease and rent record with the buyer early, and agree on who handles the security deposit.

faqs.q: Is Vestavia Hills in Jefferson County or Shelby County?
faqs.a: It spans both. The county shown on your tax bill tells you which probate office records your deed.

faqs.q: What does it cost to record a deed in Vestavia Hills?
faqs.a: The state charges 50 cents per $500 of value, or fraction of $500, with credit for mortgages that already paid mortgage tax. The probate office adds a recording fee, so ask for its schedule.

faqs.q: When are Vestavia Hills property taxes due?
faqs.a: They are due October 1 and delinquent after December 31. Unpaid bills can reach a May tax sale, so clear any balance before you sell.

faqs.q: Can I sell a Vestavia Hills house that needs work?
faqs.a: Yes. Repairs are not required, and a cash buyer takes the house as is. The deed, tax and title steps match any other sale.

faqs.q: Are there city rules for selling a house here?
faqs.a: Ask the city's building and code offices about permits and inspections.
